execution_boundary.BF16: Software RNE with exact rational reference
execution_boundary.FP32: Available local scalar float32 operations independently checked

execution_boundary.domain_guarantee: Two endpoint domains at every layer/time; uniform claims only with an all-time common invariant and uniform constants

known_limits: Generic supplied graph consistency is not external complete-call provenance

Hard-branch margins require complete domain inclusion and covered effects
GPU/native BF16/general concurrency/arbitrary compiler or FMA changes uncertified
No universal learning gain, whole-host machine proof or evolving-endpoint capacity theorem
